info.prompt: First-person POV through a cracked cybernetic visor: the player's skeletal gold-gloved hand hovers over a levitating die, its faceted core emitting strobe-like pulses of electric magenta that illuminate floating alchemical dust motes, while the 140BPM heartbeat manifests as sub-bass distortion waves warping the gothic-circuitry walls of the void-black chamber, terminal readouts flickering "FLATLINE DETECTED" across the deteriorating HUD.
